up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are reported in document CHEMBL5728609. Output the molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES for each molecule. A molecule is considered reported in the document if it has a compound record linked to that document. Return one row per molecule, ensuring no duplicates.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728609';
